title: Burden-weighted prioritisation of RESOLVED DISEASES/READS (not drugs)
method: score = w_B*B + w_U*U + w_D*D over cited 1..5 tiers; deterministic sort by score, tie-break by primary-switch barrier depth then slug.
label: This is a prioritisation of DISEASES/READS, NOT a ranking of drugs, doses, or efficacy.
firewall_note: primary-switch gamma/barrier is shown as the structural read's place in the map and is NOT folded into the clinical priority score (it is a promoter-stiffness read, not a clinical magnitude) -- inherited verbatim from analgesic M10.
d_consistency_rule: D is bounded by the lead lever's frozen `status` (floor/cap {'approved': 4, 'clinical': 3, 'investigational': 2}/{'approved': 5, 'clinical': 3, 'investigational': 2}); the build FAILS CLOSED if any editorial D disagrees with the shipped evidence.
